ns2:section.sectionText: The course will introduce the fundamental methods and principles of spatial data analysis. Both traditional approaches and new developments will be considered and discussed, and relevant R packages and functions will be illustrated. Specifically, we will emphasize on geostatistical data which will cover kriging, spatial/spatio-temporal covariance modeling, large data computation and case studies, but we will also cover the modeling of lattice data and point patterns. Restricted to Statistics Graduate Students until Dec 1, 2014.
